subject: math
description: Classify quadrilaterals by definition, not appearance, using side, angle, diagonal, and hierarchy properties.
learningObjectives: Classify quadrilaterals using formal definitions and given properties
Distinguish parallelograms, rectangles, squares, rhombuses, trapezoids, and kites
Explain the hierarchy of special quadrilaterals
Use side, angle, and diagonal properties to justify a classification
Avoid classification errors caused by relying only on appearance
prerequisites: Recognize congruent segments and congruent angles
Use basic angle relationships from parallel lines
Know that a quadrilateral has four sides
